We match you with a vetted local accountant who knows your part of the city — from CBD professionals to Tea Tree Gully small businesses and Marion hospitality.

mainEntity.name: How do I find a registered accountant in Adelaide through your service?

acceptedAnswer.text: Enter your Adelaide postcode and what you need help with in our 60-second questionnaire. We match you with a vetted Adelaide accountant whose services fit your situation — not just any firm on a map. You can verify any agent on the public TPB register at tpb.gov.au.

mainEntity.name: Are all the Adelaide accountants in your network registered tax agents?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Every accounting firm in our Adelaide network is thoroughly vetted. They are fully qualified Registered Tax Agents, CPAs, or Chartered Accountants — all registered with the Tax Practitioners Board (TPB) and operating in compliance with South Australian and Australian Tax Office (ATO) standards.

mainEntity.name: Can an Adelaide accountant help with both my personal tax return and my small business?

acceptedAnswer.text: Absolutely. Many Adelaide firms handle both individual returns and business accounting. Whether you need a personal tax return in Norwood, company tax structuring in the Adelaide CBD, or SMSF advice in Glenelg, we match you with an Adelaide specialist suited to your exact requirements across the CBD and surrounding suburbs.

mainEntity.name: What if I need an accountant who understands Adelaide's property market and South Australian tax rules?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adelaide's property landscape and South Australian state taxes — stamp duty, land tax with a general threshold of $833,000 (and a $25,000 trust threshold), and payroll tax above $1.5 million in annual wages (phasing up to the full 4.95% rate at $1.7 million) — interact with federal tax in complex ways. We match you with an Adelaide accountant who understands SA's rules and how they apply to investment property, negative gearing changes and capital gains across the Adelaide market.

mainEntity.name: How quickly will an Adelaide accountant contact me after I complete the questionnaire?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most matches are completed within 60 seconds of finishing the questionnaire. Your matched Adelaide firm will typically reach out within 2 hours, or you can call for immediate assistance to discuss your needs and schedule a consultation at their Adelaide office or by phone.

mainEntity.name: Is the Adelaide matching service really free with no obligation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Our matching service is 100% free with zero obligation. You can speak with your matched Adelaide accountant, review their initial offer, and decide if you want to proceed — no pressure, no hidden fees. We are engaged by the accounting firms, not by you.

mainEntity.name: Can I get an Adelaide accountant who offers phone or video consultations instead of an office visit?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Many firms in our Adelaide network offer fully digital cloud services via Xero, MYOB, and phone or Zoom consultations. You can specify whether you prefer in-person meetings in the Adelaide CBD or online service during your questionnaire — whichever suits your schedule.

mainEntity.name: Do you cover all of Adelaide or just the CBD?

acceptedAnswer.text: We cover all of Adelaide — from the CBD and inner suburbs like North Adelaide and Unley to Marion, Prospect, Tea Tree Gully and the southern coast. Enter your postcode in the questionnaire and we will match you with a vetted Adelaide accountant whose services fit your area, whether you are in the city centre or the outer suburbs.
